summary: Iter14 verification of Pocket Anchor additive expansion (My Anchor hub + 5-state Mood Pulse + Medical Translator + Nearby search + Trusted Contact ping + Medical Vault media_path + Privacy Center). Backend: 22/22 pytest passing in 13.6s (see /app/backend/tests/test_iter14_myanchor.py) — covers regression + all new endpoints + the critical auth-only-vs-subscription split. Frontend on desktop 1920 + mobile 390 verified end-to-end via Playwright with cookie session_token=test_session_1788529862368. Confirmed: (a) all 10 regression testids present on /dashboard (mood-pulse-card, anchor-link-card, tab-wall/journal/breath/guardians/memory, break-glass-card, sos-988-btn, 14-Day Mood Rhythm text); (b) 5-state Mood Pulse orb renders all 5 buttons mood-select-{grounded,hopeful,struggling,need_help,no_talk} and POST /api/mood with state=need_help/no_talk returns 200 with created_at; (c) /dashboard/health My Anchor hub renders readiness-card (with exact text 'You're anchored. Nothing needs your attention right now.'), module-i-need-help with 6 help-option-{0..5} buttons, module-emergency-card with 6 ec-toggle-* checkboxes + ec-save-btn + ec-show-btn → emergency-card-view dialog opens, module-safety-plan with all 6 sp-* textareas + sp-save-btn; (d) I Need Help routing: help-option-2 opens module-translate, help-option-0 targets SOS section — both verified; (e) Translate medical mode: translate-mode-medical renders med-symptoms/started/severity/allergies/medications inputs, translate-btn hits /api/translate/medical (real Claude Sonnet 4.6 Thai response), translate-result renders, translate-show-btn opens translate-show-card dialog; wizard mode translate-mode-wizard renders 6 wiz-* inputs (wiz-symptoms, wiz-symptoms_where, wiz-started, wiz-severity, wiz-allergies, wiz-medications); (f) Nearby Help search: GET /api/nearby?category=hospital&q=Thailand returns Thailand hospitals with `emergency` flag on every item (verified Bumrungrad Bangkok, Raffles Singapore, CIMA Costa Rica visible in UI with '24/7 emergency only' toggle); (g) trusted-contacts/ping kind=know returns 200 with sent>=0; (h) POST /api/medical kind=lab persists media_path field; (i) Privacy Center /privacy loads publicly (no session cookie required), all 8 sections rendered as section[data-testid^=privacy-], footer-privacy-link present on landing; (j) Mobile 390px /dashboard/health: scrollWidth=clientWidth=390, no horizontal overflow, My Anchor modules stack single column, Emergency Card toggles tappable. CRITICAL auth-only-vs-subscription-gated split independently verified: gate user (test_session_gate_1788760657342) receives 402 on /api/anchor, /api/anchor/readiness, /api/emergency-card, /api/translate/medical, /api/nearby but 200 on /api/safety-plan (both GET and PUT) — matches design.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1691 lines — nearing the >700-line guideline threshold; consider splitting into routers/{anchor,mood,translate,nearby,trusted,deja,med,stripe}.py to improve maintainability. Not a bug, just tech-debt.

GET/PUT /api/safety-plan intentionally auth-only (require_user) while sibling /api/anchor endpoints require subscription — good; the code comment '# safety tool: auth-only, not paywalled' documents this well. Consider mirroring the same pattern for /api/emergency-card if the product wants emergency info accessible without a paid plan (currently 402 for gate user).

translate/medical uses raw LlmChat response without a JSON schema; if the model drifts to include commentary, the card will contain non-labelled text. Consider a post-process trim to keep only lines starting with the expected labels (Symptoms/Started/Severity/Allergies/Current medication) or a follow-up regex validator.

If gate session is rotated, update via mongosh pattern in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Initial confusion on my end: the mood-pulse states are grounded/hopeful/struggling/need_help/no_talk (NOT calm/tender/heavy) and dashboard testids are tab-breath / tab-memory / break-glass-card / sos-988-btn (NOT tab-breathing / tab-vault / break-glass-archive / sos-988 / mood-rhythm-14 mentioned in the request). All these exist in the current UI — the request description used slightly outdated names.
